name: Spring Boot
subtitle: Java and Kotlin framework
creator: Pivotal (Spring Framework by Rod Johnson, 2002)
description: An opinionated way to build stand-alone Spring applications. It embeds a web server, auto-configures libraries based on what is on the classpath, and ships starters plus Actuator for health checks and metrics.

languages.youWrite: Java or Kotlin, configured in YAML or .properties

concepts.explanation: The framework creates and wires your objects (beans).
Sensible defaults based on your dependencies.

codeSamples.label: Java

pros: Huge ecosystem: Security, Data, Cloud, Batch
Excellent JVM performance with virtual threads
cons: Slow startup and high memory unless you use native images
Auto-configuration can be hard to debug

pricing.summary: Free and open source. Broadcom sells commercial and extended support.

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
